$comment: Provisional canonical identifier. Hosting at this URL is not required for validation and is not a resolution protocol. Core schema series 1.x; this file describes version 1.0.
title: Discovery Document
description: Extensible machine-readable information published for a mailbox. Clients obtain this document and interpret the capabilities they understand. Encryption and verification keys are optional capabilities, not the protocol itself.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema identifier for this document. Values under https://discovery.scomm.ai/schema/ are provisional canonical identifiers.

schemaVersion.description: Core Discovery schema version for this document's vocabulary. Distinct from the Discovery Protocol version (resolution/transport). The current defined value is 1.0. Later 1.x values may appear in additive revisions of this schema series.

capabilities.description: Core capabilities. All properties are optional. Unknown properties MUST be ignored by clients that do not understand them (open-world / additive evolution).

extensions.description: Third-party capabilities keyed by globally unique URIs. Unknown extensions MUST NOT cause rejection solely because they are unrecognized. SComm approval is not required to define an extension.
